map.name: crossings
map.summary: A canyon river runs corner to corner between the bases. It is impassable: every army, worker and expansion must use one of three fords, and the two flank fords are the neutral gold mines. Ground held at a ford is ground the enemy cannot walk around.

triggers.name: hero-save
triggers.sentence: when a hero drops below 35% health: move my hero to our base (trigger: hero-save, repeating every 45s)

triggers.name: army
triggers.sentence: when the clock passes 0s: idle Barracks trains Footman (trigger: army, repeating every 16s)

triggers.name: supply
triggers.sentence: when we are supply capped: worker workers builds Farm at the nearest legal site to our base (trigger: supply, repeating every 25s)

triggers.name: expand
triggers.sentence: when a mine at our base runs dry: worker workers builds TownHall at the nearest legal site to northeast mine (trigger: expand)

triggers.name: home-guard
triggers.sentence: when the base is attacked: squad 1 takes the turtle stance: defends our base within 14, leashed to 20, retreat below 45% to its anchor, focus Siege > Cavalry (trigger: home-guard, repeating every 40s)
